question: How did total net revenue, net income and return on equity change over the last three years?

answer.summary: Total net revenue grew steadily over the three-year window, rising from $121.65B in FY2021 [F06823] to $128.69B in FY2022 [F06796] and reaching $158.10B in FY2023 [F06769]. Net income moved in the opposite direction in FY2022, declining from $48.33B in FY2021 [F00080] to $37.68B in FY2022 [F00079], before recovering to $49.55B in FY2023 [F00078], exceeding the FY2021 level. Return on equity followed the net income pattern, falling from 16.4% in FY2021 [F13531] to 12.8% in FY2022 [F13532] (-358 bps) and rebounding to 16.0% in FY2023 [F13533] (+313 bps). The FY2022 compression in net income and ROE coincides with a period of only modest revenue growth. FY2023 delivered the strongest revenue growth and a net income recovery that restored ROE to near FY2021 levels.
drivers: The evidence does not contain an ATTRIBUTION block decomposing total net revenue or net income change by segment; no component-level % of total change is available for the company total.

Net income declined from $48.33B in FY2021 [F00080] to $37.68B in FY2022 [F00079] then recovered to $49.55B in FY2023 [F00078], driving the ROE trough-and-rebound pattern, as ROE is a function of net income relative to average equity.
Stockholders' equity grew +12.2% YoY to $327.88B at @2023-12-31 [F00225], providing a larger equity base that ROE recovered against in FY2023.
risks_and_red_flags: Net income accounting identity (Net income = Pre-tax income - Taxes) failed at all three quarterly points, with off-by amounts of -$64.93B, -$47.14B and -$60.92B; the quarterly net income facts @2021-12-31, @2022-12-31 and @2023-12-31 are all marked CHECK-FAILED [F08877][F08876][F07786].
Quarterly net income values (@2021-12-31 -$3.71B, @2022-12-31 -$743.00M, @2023-12-31 $1.24B) are all marked CHECK-FAILED and should not be relied upon [F08877][F08876][F07786].
ROE narrative values in management text (17.0%, 13.2%, 16.0% for 2021, 2022, 2023) [T04463] conflict with the SERIES ROE values (16.4%, 12.8%, 16.0%) [F13531][F13532][F13533].
Duplicate facts with conflicting values were set aside during parsing for these metrics.

Quarterly net income facts @2021-12-31, @2022-12-31, @2023-12-31 are CHECK-FAILED and excluded from analysis.
ROE figures differ between the SERIES (16.4%/12.8%/16.0%) and narrative management text (17.0%/13.2%/16.0%) for FY2021/FY2022/FY2023.

outlook.actuals_view: FY2023 actuals show a full recovery: net income of $49.55B [F00078] exceeded FY2021's $48.33B [F00080], ROE returned to 16.0% [F13533] from the FY2022 trough of 12.8% [F13532], and revenue reached $158.10B [F06769].
